questions.q: In Anthropic's Messages API, which two fields are actually required in a request?
questions.explain: Every other field — system, temperature, stream, tools — is optional. Only model and max_tokens are mandatory.

questions.q: In a Messages API response, what type of value is content?
questions.explain: content is always an array — later lessons show it holding tool_use blocks and structured JSON, not just text.

options: The model hit the max_tokens limit
The model is waiting for a tool result
questions.explain: end_turn means the model reached a natural stopping point on its own, not a cutoff or error.

questions.q: How does OpenAI's Chat Completions API wrap its reply, compared to Anthropic's response?
options: Inside a choices array, rather than a top-level content field
Exactly the same way, field for field
As a plain string with no structure
questions.explain: OpenAI's response nests the reply as choices[0].message.content; Anthropic returns content directly on the response object.

questions.q: Where does OpenAI's Chat Completions API put system instructions?
options: In a separate top-level system field, same as Anthropic
As a message with role "system" inside the messages array
OpenAI has no way to set system instructions
questions.explain: OpenAI treats system as just another role inside messages; Anthropic instead uses a separate top-level system parameter (Lesson 14).
